sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check the current state and try clicking on the blue blob
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find blue blob
b_blob = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 10]
print(f"Blue blob: {len(b_blob)}")
for b in b_blob:
    rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
    print(f"  at ({min(rows)},{min(cols)}), pixels={b['pixels']}")
    # Print boundary
    print(f"  boundary: {b['boundary']}")

# Find magenta squares
m_squares = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 4]
print(f"\nMagenta squares: {len(m_squares)}")
for m in m_squares:
    rows = [p[0] for p in m['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in m['boundary']]
    print(f"  at ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})")

# Try clicking on the blue blob center
if b_blob:
    b = b_blob[0]
    rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"\nClicking on blue blob center: ({center_row}, {center_col})")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
